text:
When U.S. and Canadian hotel owners prioritize **operational autonomy, conversion flexibility, or preservation of an existing identity**, the usual shortlist centers on **soft brands, collection brands, and membership-style affiliations**.

### Major-chain collection and soft brands

| Hotel company | Brands commonly considered | Typical fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott** | **Autograph Collection, Tribute Portfolio, The Luxury Collection** | Independent upper-upscale and luxury hotels seeking Marriott Bonvoy and Marriott distribution while retaining an individual name and concept. **Series by Marriott** is another flexible option, particularly for established regional portfolios in the United States and Canada. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **Tapestry Collection, Curio Collection, Outset Collection**, and **LXR** at the luxury level | Tapestry and Curio are established conversion choices with flexible frameworks. Outset, launched in 2025, provides broader flexibility in amenities and food-and-beverage programming and specifically targets substantial U.S. and Canadian growth. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hiltons-curio-and-tapestry-collections-celebrate-200th-hotel-milestones?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **The Unbound Collection, JdV by Hyatt, Destination by Hyatt, Unscripted by Hyatt** | Unbound serves distinctive upper-upscale and luxury assets; JdV emphasizes neighborhood lifestyle hotels; Destination suits resorts; Unscripted provides a lighter-touch model for upscale full- or focused-service conversions. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/development/ourbrands/theunboundcollectionbyhyatt?utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG** | **Vignette Collection** and, where somewhat more standardization is acceptable, **voco** | Vignette preserves a luxury hotel’s name, look and identity. voco is technically a more defined conversion brand but uses succinct standards, flexible design application and a comparatively efficient operating model. ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/vignette-collection?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Choice Hotels** | **Ascend Hotel Collection** | A longstanding upscale soft-brand option, particularly attractive to entrepreneurial owners seeking relatively limited design and amenity constraints. ([choicehotelsdevelopment.com](https://www.choicehotelsdevelopment.com/sfsites/c/cms/delivery/media/MCUMJCKAM4XNGDBGYQ36NVQN55WE?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Wyndham** | **Trademark Collection by Wyndham** | Frequently considered for upper-midscale and upscale conversions where owners want to retain the hotel’s name, design and local positioning. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/brand/trademark-collection-by-wyndham/?utm_source=openai)) |
| **BWH Hotels** | **BW Signature Collection, BW Premier Collection, WorldHotels collections**; sometimes **SureStay Collection** at lower positioning | Particularly relevant when owners favor independent operation or BWH’s member-owner structure. BW Premier explicitly emphasizes independent-operation flexibility, while WorldHotels offers a softer affiliation for upscale and luxury independents. ([development.bwhhotels.com](https://development.bwhhotels.com/content/developers/en_US/portfolio.html?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **Handwritten Collection, MGallery** | Less ubiquitous than the largest U.S. systems but increasingly considered for North American boutique and conversion projects. Handwritten emphasizes flexible standards, operational flexibility and retention of individual identity. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/handwritten-collection-50-hotels?utm_source=openai)) |

### Looser affiliation or representation alternatives

Owners wanting **even more operational independence**—and willing to accept less integration than a major-chain franchise—often evaluate:

- **Preferred Hotels & Resorts**
- **The Leading Hotels of the World**, primarily for qualifying luxury properties
- **Design Hotels**
- **WorldHotels**, particularly under a lighter affiliation arrangement

These models generally focus on distribution, sales, marketing, quality assurance and loyalty access while leaving more of the hotel’s operating concept intact. Preferred explicitly promotes a flexible approach for independent owners; Leading Hotels focuses on selectively admitted independent luxury hotels; Design Hotels uses a non-franchise affiliation model. ([preferredhotels.com](https://preferredhotels.com/bulletin/preferred-hotels-resorts-welcomes-13-new-member-hotels?utm_source=openai))

### Practical way to frame the shortlist

- **Maximum major-chain reach, moderate flexibility:** Autograph, Curio, Tapestry, Tribute, Unbound.
- **Broad conversion flexibility at upscale or upper-midscale:** Outset, Unscripted, Ascend, Trademark, Handwritten.
- **Luxury identity preservation:** Luxury Collection, LXR, Vignette, Unbound, MGallery, Leading Hotels.
- **Member-owned or independent-operation emphasis:** BWH collections and WorldHotels.
- **Loosest affiliation:** Preferred, Leading Hotels, or Design Hotels.

“Soft” does **not** mean unrestricted: these affiliations still impose quality standards, technology and reservation requirements, loyalty participation, fees, property-improvement obligations and contract terms. The meaningful comparison is therefore the actual franchise or membership agreement—not simply the brand’s marketing description. Broadly, soft brands occupy the middle ground between a traditional hard brand and full independence, offering chain distribution with greater flexibility over facilities, services and operations. ([cbre.ca](https://www.cbre.ca/insights/briefs/soft-brands-a-third-alternative?utm_source=openai))
